name: Murdoc
title: Warehouse Keeper

warehouse/30521.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Murdoc: Welcome to this branch of the Iron Gate Guild ! We are the oldest and largest of the 6 major Dwarven guilds, with warehouses in every city! What can I do for you, friend?

warehouse/30521-noteach.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Murdoc: Heh, heh, heh. You are a funny person. I am Murdoc of the great Iron Gate! If you have a headache, take some medicine! Normal Dwarves like myself can never understand how it is that you do not even know your own profession!

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30521-01..text: Warehouse Keeper Murdoc: Has Brunon sent you? Ah ha! You came to the right place! I was going to visit him regarding the same matter! I opened the Treasure Chest I got from Brunon, and was very surprised to find a jewel in it! I then realized that the Treasure Chests must have been switched. But th…

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30521-02..text: Warehouse Keeper Murdoc: Hey, you! Don't be shy, and give those pastries to Warehouse Keeper Airy ! Also, tell her that I'm very sorry...

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30521-03..text: Warehouse Keeper Murdoc: My colleague Airy is very upset... Whew... Well, it's all my fault... What should I do...
